title: Step commutes with the configuration embedding
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $r$ be a natural number, and let $d\colon\mathbb{N}\to\{0,1\}$. Fix an input $x$, an amplified-machine configuration $D$, an index $j\in\{0,\ldots,r\}$, a counter $c\in\{0,\ldots,r+1\}$, a configuration $u$ of $N$ on $x$ whose state is not halted, and a choice bit $b$. Applying one step with choice $b$ to the amplified machine's embedding of $u$ at $(j,c)$ gives the same configuration as embedding the result of applying one step with choice $b$ to $u$ at $(j,c)$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
